title: German Speaking Customer Service Coordinator

title: Export & Sales Administrator
description:
Export & Sales Administrator Accrington Competitive Salary + Benefits

Ready to take your export and sales administration experience to the next level?

Isothane are looking for an experienced Export & Sales Administrator to join our busy team in Accrington. This is a varied and important role, combining UK and international sales administration, customer service and export coordination.

You'll be the person making sure orders move smoothly from initial receipt through to dispatch, while keeping customers informed and ensuring every piece of export documentation is accurate and compliant.

If you're organised, commercially minded and already know your way around international shipping and export documentation, this could be a great opportunity to make your mark.

Key Responsibilities of the Export & Sales Administrator:
- Processing UK and international customer orders from receipt through to dispatch.
- Accurately entering and managing orders through the company's ERP/business system.
- Coordinating export shipments with freight forwarders and logistics providers.
- Preparing and checking commercial invoices, packing lists, Certificates of Origin, shipping and customs documentation.
- Ensuring export documentation meets regulatory and customer requirements.
- Liaising with UK and international customers regarding orders, deliveries and shipping queries.
- Monitoring order progress and proactively dealing with delays or issues.
- Working closely with Sales, Production, Warehouse and Logistics to ensure orders are delivered on time.
- Keeping customer and order records accurate and up to date.
- Providing wider administrative and customer support to the Sales team.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in Export Sales Administration, Export Coordination or a similar role.
- Strong knowledge of export procedures, international shipping and documentation.
- Experience processing sales orders within a manufacturing, distribution or trading environment.
- Experience working with freight forwarders and logistics providers.
- Excellent organisational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
- Strong communication and customer service skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook and Word.
- Experience using an ERP/MRP system.
- Knowledge of customs procedures and international trade regulations.
- The ability to work independently, prioritise effectively and keep multiple orders moving at once.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience
- 25 days holiday + bank holidays
- Company pension scheme
- Medicash
- Full-time, permanent position
- A varied role within a busy UK and international sales environment

Ready for your next move?

If you have solid export administration experience and enjoy being at the heart of the order-to-delivery process, we'd love to hear from you. APPLY NOW for immediate consideration.

description: We are looking to find the perfect fit to join the reception team at our GP Practice. The role of the GP Receptionist is fast-paced, and can at times be very demanding, so we are looking for an individual who is confident and resilient; with a professional attitude and an empathetic manner. Excellent communication and IT skills are essential, and candidates must be highly organised and also good at multi-tasking. The position is part time, working 27.75 hours over three days Processing in person, telephone and online requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations and ensuring patients are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional. Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with practice procedures. Providing clerical assistance to practice staff, including word/data processing, filing, photocopying and scanning. To act on patient requests with respect, sympathy and confidentiality. To deal with frustrated or upset patients in a professional manner, and to respond to any unpredictable situation that may arise. The Receptionist will be responsible for undertaking a wide range of reception duties and the provision of general support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties can include, but are not limited to, greeting and directing patients, the effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, the processing of information (electronic and hard copy) in a timely manner and in accordance with current policies, assisting patients as required and supporting the administration team with patient registration. The post-holder will act as the central point of contact for patients, be responsible for the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaise with multi-disciplinary team members and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. The Receptionist will support staff with the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaising with multidisciplinary team members and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers.
